description: This source file defines the internal sealed class 'SiloConnectionFactory' which extends 'ConnectionFactory' and manages the creation and configuration of silo connections in the Orleans runtime. It includes dependency injection setup, connection initialization, and configuration logic specific to silo connections.

classes.name: SiloConnectionFactory
classes.description: A sealed class responsible for establishing and configuring silo-to-silo connections within Orleans runtime, including initialization and connection management logic.

methods.name: SiloConnectionFactory
methods.description: Constructor that initializes dependencies and options needed to create silo connections.

methods.name: ConnectAsync
methods.description: Overrides base method to ensure silo connection factory is initialized and checks if the target silo is dead before attempting to connect.

methods.name: CreateConnection
methods.description: Overrides base method to create a new 'SiloConnection' instance with provided address and connection context.

methods.name: ConfigureConnectionBuilder
methods.description: Configures the connection builder using options specific to silo outbound connections.

methods.name: EnsureInitialized
methods.description: Initializes shared resources like message center, connection manager, and silo status oracle if not already done.
